text:
kevin: noticed a retry and TLS-handshake spike at ~11:07 UTC across eu-west + us-east. looks like route flip + DNS TTL + cert rotation timing caused a short window of mismatched certs on fallback backends. opening this thread to track follow-ups and owners.

maria: saw the same. trace shows clients retrying within their local resolver TTL and landing on fallback pool that had rotated certs a minute later. intermittent SNI rejects and 502s.

oliver: i've got logs indicating fallback-pool-3 had cert chain updated ~2025-12-02T11:06:40Z while main pool updated at 11:05:30Z. small delta but enough for some clients.

sam: repro in perf env: TTL=240s + immediate routing change -> subset of SDKs keep sending to old IP then LB routes to fallback with different SNI handling.

kevin: proposed actions:
1) cert rotation audit + ensure deterministic ordering + pre-warm validation (owner: oliver, ETA: 72h)
2) LB fallback gating: require TLS handshake sanity check before marking fallback healthy (owner: jess, ETA: 5 days)
3) reduce DNS TTL for edge zones during active rollouts 240->90s and document tradeoffs (owner: sam, ETA: 36h)
4) create cross-region retry dashboard & alert (owner: maria, ETA: 48h)
5) add recurring-issue note + quarterly runbook review (owner: kevin, ETA: EOW)

maria: i'll build the dashboard using metric `frontend.retry_rate` with tags region, route, and backend_pool. will add a 1.5x baseline alert and a delta-by-region panel.

oliver: for cert audit i'll add a cert-compare step to the rotation job that ensures cert.serial + notBefore match across pools before cutover. thinking to publish a small preflight endpoint `/health/cert` returning `{ok:true, serial:"..."}`. will PR.

jess: gating idea: add a handshake-health probe that performs a TLS client hello and verifies SNI + cert chain on candidate fallback instances. only mark pool as healthy when probes pass. will add config and rollback playbook.

sam: TTL change note: we must coordinate with registrar rate limits. snippet i'll run during maintenance: 
```
# change edge TTL to 90s
gcloud dns record-sets transaction start --zone=redwood-edge
# replace A records with TTL=90
```
I'll coordinate netops and schedule 2025-12-03 09:00 UTC.

kevin: please add links to PRs and trackers here. Also let's add a short acceptance test: simulate route flip with current SDKs and verify no >1% SNI failure after gating. owner: jess + oliver.

maria: tracker: https://redwood-internal/triage/ISSUE-5024 created, tasks added and owners assigned.

jess: LB gating branch pushed: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/812 staging canary scheduled for today. includes rollback command `infra rollback lb-gating --to previous`.

oliver: cert preflight PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/815 (adds cert-check endpoint + rotation ordering). staging tests green.

sam: DNS TTL change prepped in sandbox. registrar check done, maintenance scheduled 2025-12-03 09:00 UTC. ops-bot put reminder.

kevin: recurring incident note: pattern seen 4 times over last year. i'll add a summary to docs/recurring-network-issues.md and schedule runbook review for 2026-01-05.

maria: dashboard work started; ETA 48h. will wire alert to #oncall.

jess: can we add a temporary mitigation: TTL rebinding script to quickly revert TTL to 300s if gating fails? i'll add commands to playbook.

sam: will standby for revert. also will monitor registry rate limits during update.

ops-bot: Automated: maintenance window created for DNS TTL update on 2025-12-03T09:00Z (owner: sam). Reminder set 1h before.

kevin: thanks all. please post short status updates here when you start and when complete. we'll convene 10m check-in 2025-12-03 08:50 UTC to confirm rollout readiness.

maria: started dashboard panels (wip).

oliver: cert audit in progress; doing cross-pool serial comparisons.

jess: gating tests running in staging canary now.

sam: sandbox TTL update verified; will execute in prod during window.

kevin: resolving this thread into ISSUE-5024 and marking owners. will follow up after the prod window and keep an eye on retry metrics for 72h post-change.

maria: will alert if region delta >15% within 2h of change. :eyes:

ops-bot: Automated: follow-up checklist updated in ISSUE-5024 by maria.
